fee_notes: Standard Franchise Fee is $30,000 (up to 60,000 households Operating Territory). Hometown Market fee is $15,000 (up to 30,000 households). Multiple discount programs apply: Technician to Owner Pathway (50%-100% off); Existing Business discount (50%-100% based on annual gross sales); Additional Franchise discount (10% or 25%); Employee/Franchisee Employee discount (10%-25% based on years of service); Veteran discount (20%). Fee is due upon execution of the Franchise Agreement and is nonrefundable. Also includes a separate Zr Ware initial fee of $1,500 and training for up to two people.
raw_excerpt: In order to acquire a ZEROREZ Franchise you must pay to ZEROREZ an initial lump sum initial franchise fee ("Franchise Fee") of $30,000 or, if you purchase a Hometown Market (as defined below), $15,000. This Franchise Fee includes an Operating Territory with (i) up to 60,000 households, as agreed upon and determined according to the most recently available U.S. Census (the "Census"), or (ii) up to 30,000 households if you purchase a hometown market (a "Hometown Market") Operating Territory.
